name: 45449 · W Carrollton, OH
findings: ZIP 45449 (W Carrollton) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45449 (W Carrollton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45449 (W Carrollton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).
